# Recommended Approach: Story 3.4

**Generated:** 2026-08-12  
**Generated by:** @architect (Vega)

Use the existing monolith and command/repository boundaries. Add the CLI-first data operations, isolated SheetJS CE 0.20.3 parser, immutable workspace-scoped receipts, owner-only hashed API keys, versioned route handlers, generic webhook authority, and separate health/readiness contracts described in `data-portability-operational-api.md`.

Implementation order: parser/config/tests; SQL/RLS/repositories; CLI; API keys/endpoints; webhook/health; UI; full QA. No provider activation, raw-file retention or deployment claim belongs to this story.
